guidance: Separate confirmed evidence from hypothesis. Record only a root cause that evidence supports, and never treat a guess as the cause. Keep reproduction steps exact enough that a stranger can follow them.

outline.title: Issue Summary
outline.guidance: Contrast what happened with what should have happened, and who is affected. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Observed Behaviour
children.guidance: Describe the failing behaviour as observed. Quote logs, errors, or UI text when you have them.

children.title: Expected Behaviour
children.guidance: State the correct behaviour, citing the spec or contract when one exists.

children.title: Impact
children.guidance: Name who is affected, how often it happens, and the severity. Do not inflate impact you cannot observe.

outline.title: Reproduction
outline.guidance: Group the cases a stranger can follow to see the bug. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Reproduction Case
children.guidance: Title each instance with the failing scenario name, not "Reproduction Case".

children.title: Preconditions
children.guidance: List the environment, data, and account state required before the steps. Be concrete.

children.title: Steps
children.guidance: Numbered actions a stranger can follow. One action per line.

children.title: Evidence
children.guidance: Paste log snippets or link to recordings that show this case. Do not attach files; there is no file-attachment block.

outline.title: Root Cause Analysis
outline.guidance: Explain the confirmed cause and why tests missed it. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Root Cause
children.guidance: State the confirmed cause and the evidence that supports it. If the cause is still unknown, say so — do not record a guess.

children.title: Contributing Factors
children.guidance: List conditions that made the bug more likely. Omit if none are known.

children.title: Regression Gap
children.guidance: Name the missing test, check, or review that would have caught this before release.

outline.title: Fix Strategy
outline.guidance: Bound the change, its risks, and how you will prove it. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Proposed Change
children.guidance: Describe the smallest change that removes the confirmed cause. Do not expand into unrelated refactors.

children.title: Risks and Rollback
children.guidance: List side effects of the fix and how to revert if it fails.

children.title: Verification
children.guidance: List the checks that prove the bug is gone and that the regression gap is closed.

children.title: Implementation Record
children.guidance: Optional append-only leaf used after a release. Title each instance with the date and the change, and write the record in the instance body. Do not pre-fill.
